'''2008 Worlds Day 3 Kyle Krueger LS Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Krueger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
